text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I am sorry.
I couldn't win this time either...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Far from giving everyone hope,
all I do is disappoint them with my pathetic running.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"To connect people around the world through racing,
so that no one ever feels lonely, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Was that too much to wish for, I wonder?
With these legs of mine, bringing about
such great hope is simply beyond me—
choice_data_list: Facing hardship head-on is what brings hope.

Are you really okay with letting the bonds we've forged this far just vanish?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Yes, that's right, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Giving up means
snuffing out the light of hope with your own hands...
Even if I keep losing, that's the one thing I'll never do.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I will rise up, starting right here.
To bring hope to the world...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No... you mustn't.
I will never allow our connection to be severed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I apologize.
It seems I was being a bit faint-hearted.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just little by little,
so as not to let this chain of hope break,
I will keep on running!
